card.name: Words leading into a medical effect or condition
card.fires_on: Words that set up a named disease, effect or finding, such as 'affect', 'affecting', or 'a' after 'produce'. Also partway through disease words like thrombophlebitis and neuroma.

modes.label: Affect verbs
modes.description: The verb 'affect', 'affected' or 'affecting' before a body system or function.
modes.example: Other disorders<< affecting>> mineral metabolism (such as vitamin D deficiency

modes.label: Inside disease names
modes.description: Partway through long condition names, before the ending.

modes.label: Article or number before a finding
modes.description: A small word or percent sign leading into a reported effect or rate.
modes.example: can often produce<< a>> reduction in the cholinesterase level

card.writes: It seems to push away words like 'symptoms' and pain terms, and favors odd material or unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on words that lead into a named condition or effect, such as 'affecting' or the middle of a disease name.
